corrections.previous: To evaluate the expression of T cell surface markers by flow cytometry, we incubated tissue and blood cell suspensions with Human TruStain FcX (BioLegend) and stained with following fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies: CD3 (UCHT1, BD Biosciences; OKT3, BioLegend), CD4 (SK3, BD Biosciences; SK3, Tonbo Biosciences), CD8 (SK1, BioLegend; RPA-T8, BD Biosciences), CCR7 (G043H7; BioLegend), CD45RA (HI100; BioLegend), CD25 (BC96; BioLegend), CD127 (A019D5; BioLegend), CD69 (FN50; BioLegend), CD103 (Ber-ACT8; BioLegend), CD45 (HI30; BioLegend), and Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 (eBioscience). We acquired cell fluorescence data using a BD LSR II flow cytometer and used FCS Express (De Novo Software) for analysis.
